newsitem.title: USA: Bradlees business transition hurts 1st half.
newsitem.headline: Bradlees business transition hurts 1st half.

text.p: Bradlees Inc said Tuesday its sales in the first half were hurt by its transition from low-margin businesses to more financially viable businesses and the overall weak retailing climate.
Gross margin was hurt in the second quarter, primarily by higher markdowns, costs associated with the closing of 14 stores announced in May and bankruptcy expenses, it said.
The current year's net loss included $40.9 million in reorganization charges, and the second quarter of 1995 included an $8.0 million reorganization charge, the company said.

The company said comparable store sales declined 10 percent for the quarter and year-to-date comparable store sales declined 11 percent. However, it said, August comparable store sales excluding the closing stores were up 12.2 percent over August 1995.
